title: CogArena: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents on Interactive Behavioral Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2610.36484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Claims about the cognitive capabilities of large language models are typically tested by translating behavioral paradigms into text prompts, bypassing the visual interfaces and time pressure through which human participants actually engage with experiments. At the same time, AI agents can now complete online behavioral tasks and produce human-like data, which raises concerns that online datasets in the social and behavioral sciences are increasingly open to contamination. We introduce CogArena, a benchmark of ten experimental paradigms from the social and behavioral sciences. Agents complete the experiments through a standard web browser, working with the same visual stimuli and response interfaces that online participants use. A three-level scoring procedure evaluates whether the agent completed the task, how accurately it performed, and whether its data show the behavioral signatures each paradigm reliably produces in people. translated_title: CogArena：基于交互式行为实验的多模态智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 关于大型语言模型认知能力的论断，通常是通过将行为范式转化为文本提示来检验的，这种方式绕过了人类被试实际参与实验时所面对的视觉界面与时间压力。与此同时，AI智能体现在已能够完成在线行为任务并产生类似人类的数据，这引发了人们的担忧：社会科学与行为科学领域的在线数据集正日益面临被污染的风险。我们提出了CogArena，这是一个包含十个来自社会科学与行为科学实验范式的基准测试。智能体通过标准网页浏览器完成实验，使用与在线人类被试相同的视觉刺激和反应界面。一个三级评分程序用于评估智能体是否完成了任务、其表现的准确性如何，以及其数据是否呈现出每种范式在人类被试身上可靠产生的行为特征。
tldr: 提出CogArena基准，让多模态智能体通过真实网页浏览器以与人类被试相同的视觉界面完成十个行为科学实验范式，并采用“任务完成度—准确性—行为特征”三级评分来检验AI认知能力，同时应对在线行为数据被AI污染的问题。
en_tdlr: CogArena is a benchmark of ten social and behavioral science experiment paradigms in which multimodal agents complete tasks through real web browsers with human-identical visual interfaces, assessed by a three-level scoring procedure measuring task completion, accuracy, and behavioral signatures.
